content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the panevėžys district court the court has made a final resolution regarding the division of matrimonial property between the applicant and the defendant the court has determined the value of various properties including land vehicles and personal belongings the court has ordered certain items to be awarded to each party additionally the court has declared the ownership of two cars in favor of the defendant and ordered them to pay compensation to the applicant for a greater share of the property the court has also addressed outstanding loans and determined the costs to be paid by each party the court has upheld the action brought by the applicant and the counterclaim brought by the defendant and has decided to dissolve the marriage due to fault on both sides the court has approved an agreement regarding a credit agreement and exempted the defendant from paying a state stamp duty both parties have been ordered to pay their respective costs and the state costs of the proceedings
